ledger_ref.description: rename the driver-private bitfield shift macro so 6.12.111 headers can build i12

snapshot.path: installed i12 DKMS tree after 030-035; not a new archived snapshot

semantics.summary: 6.12.111 defines __bf_shf as the object-like macro __builtin_ctzll. The i12 header still defines a function-like __bf_shf, and -Werror stops the DKMS build. Rename only the driver-private macro to __fant_bf_shf and keep (__builtin_ffsll(x) - 1). Do not undef or ifndef the kernel macro.

license.evidence: Three-token rename in the existing vendor Dual MIT/GPLv2 header; no new dependency, binary or third-party code.

dependencies.summary: Parent is the locked 5.0.0-i12 tree 9a8d185f, which already contains 030-035 plus the i8-i11 derivations. 030-036 is not inserted into scripts/build-innogpu-driver.sh and does not change that gate. fantgpu/fant_math.h is byte-identical between the locked i6 snapshot and that i12 tree.

o_stage_adaptation.summary: No Deepin behavior change. The D-line header drivers/innogpu/inno_math.h is not a DKMS compile input and is outside this patch.

adjacent_code.summary: The installed i12 tree uses __bf_shf only on the definition line and the two FANT_FIELD_PREP/FANT_FIELD_GET expansions in fantgpu/fant_math.h.

apply.result: One file, three token renames; strict dry-run and replay on the i12 tree and on the byte-identical i6 header pass; no .orig/.rej. The i6 replay hash is not the i12 deployment hash.

checks: strict -p1 --fuzz=0 application to the locked i6 snapshot header, which matches the i12 file bytes
exact scope fantgpu/fant_math.h with three __bf_shf to __fant_bf_shf renames
reverse application restores the locked i6 tree hash
i12 builder script still gates 9a8d185f and does not reference 030-036
DKMS make.log exit 0 with MODPOST and BTF [M]

shipped ABI size=140536 members=115 pvr_resume_count offset=140528

runtime.required: After install and a user reboot into 111: fantgpu loaded, DRM card present, Xorg glamor, input attached, eight error counts, both Hygon 1d94:148c quirks=0x90, and one unplug/plug BAT0 recovery. No PM and no GRUB default change.
